R7BK-duck-drive-0003.name: Unnamed wetland 170 m SE of Fort Nelson River
R7BK-duck-drive-0003.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R7BK-duck-drive-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Nelson Mainline (paved road)

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 19.5 ha, 70 m from the road.
About 5 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Fort Nelson River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 276 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 7-49, Region 7B Omineca. Near the MU line: check the MU map.

seasonRows.notes: District 7. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Old Fort Nelson, about 56 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Kotcho Mainline, Sierra Yoyo Desan Rd, Nelson Mainline.
Park: 59.18795, -122.80369, pull off on Nelson Mainline (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 80 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-49, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-08-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BK-duck-drive-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-49: about 2,940 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.27 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R7BK-grouse-walk-0001.name: 2.2 km N of Fort Nelson River
R7BK-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7BK-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
5 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Old Fort Nelson, about 60 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.21637, -122.78398, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk 250 m to the start. Walk: the resource road stretch, 5.7 km one way. About 114 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-55, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
